originality.rationale: Komatsu–Ying prove p-Frobenius and p-Apéry data only through p=floor(a/2). The inspected 2026 three-phase result covers g_p for the same denominations and gives a generic denumerant summation, but does not formulate the interior-nongap intervals or the universal quadratic p-genus defect throughout the second phase. Earlier scientific results at the first odd post-boundary level and for even denominators do not determine the full odd second-phase formula. The known g_p endpoint alone does not imply the genus; the general counting identity does imply it after a nontrivial complete tent-profile analysis. This creates an acknowledged risk of an equivalent unstated or unindexed corollary; external search cannot prove novelty.
residual_risks: The published general exact denumerant sum can yield this structural result by residue casework; its classification as a previously obvious/unrecorded corollary is a mathematical priority risk.
Unindexed literature may already contain the full post-threshold genus/gap-set classification.
